description: Write a sprint review deck from the git history: themes in business language, each point checked against the real commits, with screenshots when configured. Writes deck.html, review.json, review.md and checks.md (and deck.pptx when asked) and returns their paths, the check log and the cost. Replaces an earlier deck in the same folder. Calls the configured model, so it needs that provider's key in the server environment (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY by default, or GEMINI_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY and others); a review costs about $0.02 to $0.30. Reads pull requests from GitHub when GITHUB_TOKEN is set. Takes 20 seconds to 3 minutes.

directory.description: The project folder: a git repository, with or without sprint-review.config.yml. Default: the folder the server started in.

from.description: Start after this tag or commit instead of a date, e.g. v1.4.0.

out.description: Folder to write to. Default: sprint-reviews/<last day of the sprint>.

pptx.description: Also write deck.pptx, an editable PowerPoint with speaker notes. Default: false.

since.description: First day of the sprint, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: the configured sprint length (two weeks unless set) back from until.

to.description: End at this tag or commit. Default: HEAD.

until.description: Last day of the sprint, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today.

name: generate_sprint_review
title: Generate a sprint review
